text:
```yaml
name: govulncheck

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at 00:00 UTC

jobs:
  govulncheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        id: setup-go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@b625fbe08f3bccbe446d94fbf87fcc875a4f50ee
        with:
          go-version-input: ${{ steps.setup-go.outputs.go-version }}
          check-latest: false
          cache: true
          go-package: ./...
          work-dir: .
          repo-checkout: false
          go-version-file: go.mod
          output-format: json
          output-file: govulncheck.json

      - name: Upload govulncheck results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: govulncheck-results
          path: govulncheck.json
```
